1aca0bf2b8b3ca851f95eb670d778a55bd7241ec.reference: No. The canary sings in its gilt cage in the opening office scene and is half-dead and still caged at the end. McTeague is handcuffed to the dead Marcus.

65c19df71f288641474f6a6c8217473d19da1e2c.reference: Yes. The opening canary sings from a gilt cage in the office. The ending bird flies out of the broken cage while McTeague is handcuffed to the dead Marcus.
65c19df71f288641474f6a6c8217473d19da1e2c.answer: Yes. The canary, the one thing the dentist clung to with a strange obstinacy, and the tooth, the famous golden molar of French gilt, his sign, his ambition, the one unrealized dream of his life; and it was French gilt, too, not the cheap German gilt that was no good.
